note: Only evidence-backed native functional coverage and remaining HOLD statuses. Unreviewed components remain HOLD_REVIEW/HOLD_CONFLICT; catalog decisions are never installation authorization; no runtime, client activation, permission or legal-rights attestation is implied by presence in this catalog.
